entities.name: Haqikah
entities.description: A young human vizier of Hazoret from Naktamun on Amonkhet who guided Samut and Djeru's band.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet whom Haq served as vizier, who fought the Scorpion God.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A survivor who experienced a planeswalk and later re-killed Haq.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: A survivor in Samut's small band.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The God-Pharaoh whose cruelty and looming threat the survivors face.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A fallen god the group passed in Naktamun.

entities.name: The Scorpion God
entities.description: A god that pursued Hazoret and was reduced to ash by her.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: The undead army on Ravnica of which Haq became part.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Haq was re-killed.

events.summary: Samut, Djeru and their band encountered Haq, who joined them and told of Bontu's betrayal and the God-Pharaoh's cruelty.
events.quote: He had witnessed the battle between Bontu and Hazoret

events.summary: Haq guided the group past the fallen god Rhonas, where they mourned and resolved to fight.
events.quote: leading them past the fallen god Rhonas

events.summary: Hazoret appeared, injured and pursued by the Scorpion God; the survivors battled it and Hazoret reduced the god to ash.
events.quote: Hazoret delivered the final blow, reducing the god to ash.

events.summary: Samut experienced a planeswalk, returning with new abilities.
Haq, seen as part of the Dreadhorde on Ravnica, was re-killed by Samut.
events.quote: where he was re-killed by Samut

relations.quote: Haq was a young vizier of Hazoret

relations.note: On Ravnica when he was part of the Dreadhorde.
relations.quote: where he was re-killed by Samut
Hazoret delivered the final blow, reducing the god to ash.
